acceptance_criteria: Traces to its accepted system and software anchors and is verified by its named checks, traceability route, or report inspection.
statement: No T038 command shall open a TCP listener or AF_INET/AF_INET6 socket, use DNS, a resolver, or TLS, contact an external peer, execute a legacy binary or production workload, or add an admitted dependency.
title: Offline, no-legacy, no new dependency
